text:
lauren: quick question for the console saved-views work  should we treat a "saved view" as one entity with a scope field (route/model/org) or keep separate DB rows for route-scoped vs model-scoped pins?
raj: prefer one entity + `scope`. simpler queries, less duplication when users edit shared views.
tessa: UX concern: if I pin a model-scoped default but a route has its own pin, which is shown by default in the route inspector? need clear rule.
oren: propose precedence: route override > model override > org default. route applies if it matches route id, otherwise fallback. keeps behavior predictable.
lauren: ok. second concern: saved views should communicate telemetry sampling and cost expectations up front. we need a preview in the editor.
raj: API suggestion for create/update:
```
POST /api/console/saved_views
{
  "name": "Latency + 5xx rate",
  "filters": {"route": "api/v1/payments", "model": "rwd/fast-13b"},
  "scope": "route", // route | model | org
  "telemetry_sampling": 0.005, // optional
  "cost_preview": {"enabled": true}
}
```
lauren: defaulting rule: if telemetry_sampling omitted, inherit org-level sampling. otherwise use explicit value. avoids accidental heavy sampling on low-traffic views.
tessa: agree. also important: backward-compat for old views that lack `scope` and `telemetry_sampling`. migration should mark them as `org` by default and flag owners to review.
oren: routing interplay: if the route has a routing policy (primary + fallbacks), cost_preview must show: primary-cost estimate and a fallback-cost estimate (worst-case). UI should label them clearly.
raj: implementation detail: current GET /v1/console/views/:id returns `filters` and `query`. We'll add `scope`, `telemetry_sampling`, `cost_preview` to the payload. rollout behind feature flag `console.views.api_v2`.
lauren: deploy-bot, can you confirm if the flag exists and how to enable a staged rollout?
deploy-bot: featureflag `console.views.api_v2` exists. currently OFF in prod. can toggle via /internal/flags. can target org lists or % rollout. last check 1764024360.
lauren: rollout plan proposal: enable for internal+staging, migrate 5% of customer views as a dry run, compare telemetry volumes and saved_views.fetch latency. gate if sampling drift > 1.5% or errors increase.
tessa: what metrics do we track specifically?
raj: track: saved_views.fetch p95, cost_preview compute latency, count of migrated views, per-view telemetry event rate (before vs after), and sampling mismatch rate.
oren: also instrument a routing-graph version tag in cost preview so we can correlate spikes when graph changes. add an alert for cost_preview failures > 1% of requests.
lauren: persistence Q: store small `versions` array for quick rollback, but store large snapshots in object store and reference via id. no inlining of full payloads.
tessa: yep. UX copy: migration prompt should read "We migrated this saved view to the new format. Review sampling & cost preview settings." keep CTA: Review or Revert.
lauren: final action items:
- raj: implement API additions + migration SQL script (PR, include sample migrated payloads)
- oren: cost_preview service: include fallback-cost logic + graph-version header + tests
- tessa: create preview UI mock (primary vs fallback columns) and migration prompt copy
- lauren: rollout doc + canary gating thresholds

lauren: ping here when PRs are up. will coordinate infra for a 5% dry-run.
raj: will open PR today and include migration plan.
lauren: thanks all :rocket:
